required_review_scope: Verify frozen B0 source and testbank identities.
Verify canonical TCD-026 classification and Class-A atomic scope.
Verify C-EX physical ownership: Ex start state, Rsex result state, Init promotion and restart persistence.
Verify current Bfom beginning/end asymmetry and exact candidate term Ex(Ln)*P.
Verify the component conservation identity and the PREP06 10 kg/ha causal discriminator.
Verify that tiny post-probe residuals are not used as tolerance.
Verify physical-state, process-flux and total-physical-mass non-interference evidence.
Verify the changed-output whitelist and negative controls.
Verify that supplied natural B1 activation is structurally unreachable because all initial orgexu values are zero, rather than silently treating non-activation as a pass.
Verify that current SYNQ01 has no TCD-026 oracle and that no unrelated oracle is substituted.
Verify live GOV02/PREP02R route eligibility before any admission decision.
Verify no composition with other organic-matter TCDs and no initialization physics change.
fail_conditions: Any physical state or initialization value must change.
Any process flux or total physical OM trajectory must change.
Any output outside the declared fresh-OM balance whitelist changes.
The causal residual is explained only by tolerance rather than the exact omitted beginning mass.
Natural activation is claimed without an actually nonzero initial Ex or a model-produced restart state.
An unrelated SYNQ oracle is presented as TCD-026-specific independent evidence.
The route gate is treated as PASS while PREP02R remains ineligible.
The same authoring activity is counted as independent review.
The review composes another organic-matter discrepancy into TCD-026.
